title: DivergeMC Resource Pack
description: A collection of custom textures as requested by members of DivergeMC
body:
![Requires Optifine or CIT Resewn to work](https://i.imgur.com/YBRtsHQ.png)

#### It took a long time but here it is...

Made in 1 hour when I was bored, the DivergeMC resource pack is a compiled pack of various custom textures requested by members. If you are a member of DivergeMC, you can request a texture by messaging me directly or by using the ["Custom textures" thread under #suggestions](https://ptb.discord.com/channels/547834426567163935/882557586111619102). If you are not a member, why are you here?

## Textures
![All custom textures with signs below to show the custom names](https://i.imgur.com/yYWtQGC.png)

Also yes I did originally upload it [here](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/divergemc-resource-pack/) on Planet Minecraft, but I've moved it to here because I want to consolidate my work to a single, very good, platform
